Now complete the sentences with the correct word – too or also.

1 Go to bed at the same time every night. You could use an app to help you sleep.

2 I think you should talk to your friends, but it’s important to listen to them.

3 Try to go for a walk every day. Perhaps you could join a sports club .

staticText.text:
Build your potential | Using too and also

We can use the adverbs too and also to add information.

• We usually put too at the end of a sentence.I usually visit my grandparents at the weekend. Sometimes I go swimming too.

• We usually put also between the subject and the verb, but after an auxiliary verb or the verb be.I usually visit my grandparents at the weekend. Sometimes I also go swimming.My friend is also going to come to my grandparents’ house next weekend.
